title: Playa Blanca | KEY.co
description_expanded: I have stayed in this home twice and cannot wait to return! The first time was a girls trip, the second time was a couples trip. The third will likely be a family trip with the kids! The house is equipped for any occasion. There is plenty of common space indoors and outside and there is also plenty of privacy. All the rooms are spacious and the beds are incredibly comfortable. We took advantage of all the wonderful restaurants within walking and biking distance. I personally love riding the bikes everywhere. There’s a lot of fun shopping for a gals trip. The beach is absolutely gorgeous and just a quick walk to get to. You could spend all day down there. I haven’t cooked because you really are on vacation in paradise but if you wanted to, the kitchen is awesome! I highly recommend this house! Tucked within the charming streets of Rosemary Beach, Playa Blanca is a refined three-level retreat designed for effortless coastal living. This elegant four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bath home welcomes up to 14 guests with beautifully curated interiors, warm natural textures, and light-filled living spaces that create a sense of relaxed sophistication. The main level flows seamlessly between the stylish living room, a chef-inspired kitchen with a gas range and integrated appliances, and a striking dining space with a live-edge table for memorable gatherings. Arched doorways lead to a serene courtyard where a private heated pool and covered lanai with an outdoor TV set the stage for laid-back afternoons and lively evenings under the Florida sky.

Features: Backyard Outdoor grill Heated pool Pool
Guests assume all risk for use of pools
